caption: The drawing features a rectangular swatch of woven fabric centered on a plain, light beige background. The fabric is predominantly blue with a repeating geometric pattern consisting of zigzag lines and rectangular shapes that are formed by alternating blue and white threads. The woven texture is visible, with clearly defined thread intersections throughout the fabric. At the bottom edge of the swatch, there is a fringe made up of loose blue and white threads extending downward, showing individual strands. The fabric swatch appears to be depicted with a high level of detail, emphasizing the textile’s structure and color contrast. There is also a small, blue signature in the lower right corner of the composition.
